name: CanonicalUser resource grant surfaces fail-closed (never silently dropped)
note: IAM-1208 (Phase 12.1, fix 4): a recognized-but-unmodeled Amazon S3 CanonicalUser principal is NOT one of the modeled resource-finding types (anonymous / named account / service / KMS account-delegation). Before this fix it produced ZERO findings - a silent drop that reads as 'safe'. The resource evaluator now fails closed toward surfacing: it emits exactly one RESOURCE-UNSUPPORTED-PRINCIPAL finding (medium) so the grant is always visible, mirroring the trust family's fail-closed invalid-principal handling. No graph can-access edge is drawn (the reach is UNDETERMINED). The policy must NOT be mis-analyzed as an identity policy (no DATA-READ / DATA-EXFIL / WILDCARD-RESOURCE).
